correctness.rationale: For theta Brownian at angular rate d, Ito on cos(theta) with resets supplies longitudinal displacement (v k/d)N(t)+martingale and centered bounded renewal rewards with L2 remainder O(t), k=1-E e^(-dT)>0. For Lomax 1<alpha<2, renewal density u(t)=1/mu+c/[mu²(alpha-1)]t^(1-alpha)+o(t^(1-alpha), justified by complete monotonicity/Stieltjes and Karamata; factorial-moment convolution yields fresh Var N~2c t^(3-alpha)/[mu³(2-alpha)(3-alpha)]. Stationary renewal pair density u(h)/mu yields the factor 1/(alpha-1). Remainder covariance grows slower since (4-alpha)/2<3-alpha for alpha<2. Sine martingale and centered odd reset rewards establish O(t) transverse variance. Independent rational coefficient calculation at alpha=3/2 gave fresh 1/3 and stationary 2/3. This is asymptotic for all 1<alpha<2, not Gaussian limit.

value.rationale: The preparation dependence is an actual measurable variance prefactor change, despite identical drift, while only the motion parallel to the reset axis is superdiffusive. This contrasts transverse and longitudinal transport and separates equilibrium-age bias from an initial reset; it is a mathematically motivated model distinction rather than only replaying generic renewal variance.
